name: DoMIME
runtimeDependencies: Voyager-format ENV:MIME.prefs with a suffix and viewer mapping
notes: Stephan Rupprecht's 23 June 2000 m68k command matches DefIcons44/DoMIME. The archive documentation describes project icons with C:DoMIME as the default tool and Shell or Workbench viewer dispatch.
BCWB supplies a Voyager-format text mapping for .txt in ENVARC:MIME.prefs. DoMIME can be invoked directly from Shell or used as a project default tool. WBStartEmu owns the shared library and handler.
